name: jump
prompt: Cosy game SFX for a tiny plush-like mascot. Warm, rounded, cushioned and very soft. Dry and isolated. No metal, rattle, creak, crackle, hiss, music or voices. One short soft rubber spring jump: a compressed bup releases into a round playful boing. A tiny plush character pushes off a cushion. Warm rubbery body, gentle attack and a short springy tail. No air, wind, whoosh or swoosh. Immediate onset, one jump.
